derived.note: target_price is arithmetic (entry ± tgtR × |entry − stop|, tgtR = 5.0 frozen). V53 does not emit a target price, so this is a derived convenience value, cross-validated against recorded P&L on every target exit — not a recorded expectation. stop_inverted marks a stop on the far side of entry, a real recorded V53 outcome that B2 must reproduce rather than correct.

not_captured: 5m and LTF pivot confirmations (ta.pivothigh/low) — never emitted per event
per-sequence displacement qualification — only the aggregate BOS+disp counter
V53 slot index (0..23) — not emitted in the ledger
sequences that armed but never filled — only aggregate funnel counters
per-bar state transitions — the ledger records one row per fill, at fill time
exit price for timeout exits — only the R multiple and USD are recorded
ATR at arm, and therefore r_atr_ratio — not emitted per event

source_notes: NOTE 1: duplicate pair again -- same entry 4404, different stop, opposite outcome.

NOTE 2: sweep Fri 2026-08-07 20:05 -> BOS Sun 2026-08-09 22:02. dispWait=12 is 12 CHART BARS, not 60 wall-clock minutes; across the weekend session gap 12 bars spans two days. My "60 minutes" phrasing in 13D holds only inside a continuous session. Frozen behaviour, reported not changed.

NOTE 3: both entries land 2026-08-09 22:10, i.e. after the fold B/C boundary (08-09 00:00). Outcome resolution for fold-B-armed sequences necessarily reads bars past the boundary -- true of every V44-V52 fold run too. No fold C run was performed and no fold C statistic was inspected.
